name: 45039 · Maineville, OH
findings: ZIP 45039 (Maineville) has 76 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45039 (Maineville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
